query: NVIDIA Gaming segment revenue Q1 fiscal 2027 Edge Computing
normalized: 2027 computing edge fiscal gaming nvidia q1 revenue segment

output.content:
NVIDIA reported **$6.4 billion of Edge Computing revenue** in **Q1 fiscal 2027** (quarter ended April 26, 2026), up **10% sequentially** and **29% year over year**. [[1]] 

This is not directly comparable to the former standalone **Gaming** segment: beginning in Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA replaced its previous market-platform presentation with two platforms—**Data Center** and **Edge Computing**—so Gaming/AI PC activity is included within the new Edge Computing platform along with other edge-related businesses. [[1]]

sources.title: NVIDIA Corporation - NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for First Quarter Fiscal 2027
